note: Large snowbird RV and golf resort on Drew Rd southwest of El Centro, about 40 ft below sea level, beside wetlands with a 9-hole course and a catch-and-release fishing lake. Mostly winter long-stay guests and park models (monthly and annual rentals), though daily and weekly RV sites are also sold. The operator markets it as an 'adult resort'; no age limit is posted. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates rendered in the browser), Google and the Good Sam/RV Life caches read. Daily RV rates posted: $40 May-September (discounted, prepaid) and at the 'Ramada' sites, $60 October-April; weekly/monthly/annual too. Good Sam Park. Price gate passes on the $40 nights. Booking is a request form the office calls back on (phone). Full hookups, open year round. Google 4.5 (481). Phone '' -> 800-545-6481. Long-stay leaning (snowbirds, park models) and 'adult resort' wording flagged.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes. Cheapest real RV night $40 (Daily May-September, discounted, paid in full on arrival; also 'Daily (At Ramada) $40.00/ Day', site type not described). Peak is $60 October-April ($54 at the Good Sam 10%, still over $50 - so winter nights alone would not pass). No gateway within 40 km (Joshua Tree NP 110 km). Google 4.5 from 481 reviews.

LONG-STAY (five tests): (1) price passes on the $40 summer nights; (2) a nightly rate is posted on the operator's own site with a phone, booked through a request form + callback (no application/approval/lease wording); (3) no RV-site minimum posted (park models need 3 months in season); (4) nightly share UNMEASURED: no booking engine and no site count on the operator site (RV Life lists 500 sites); (5) park models are marketed as 'Excellent investments' and a home-page testimonial says 'We bought a place there' - park models are being sold or owner-held; reviewer to judge whether that is 'sells homes'. It reads as mostly seasonal (snowbird) - 'Rio Bend is a Snowbird destination', 'the ideal recreational vehicle vacation resort community for winter visitors', '4 MONTHS FOR $899!' special. Note now says so.

AGE: the about page calls it 'home, community, health, recreation and beauty for adults' and 'Our premier luxury adult resort'; no age cutoff (55+) is stated anywhere I read. The stored note's 'all-ages' was unsupported and is removed. Reviewer: age-restriction question - a phone call would settle it.
PHONE: '' -> 800-545-6481 (operator footer, Google, Good Sam). Restaurant line (760) 370-3287 is the bar & grill's.
WEBSITE: https://www.riobendrvgolfresort.com live (Wix; operator Westwind Enterprises, riobend@westwindenterprises.com) - keep.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept; the 'eleven acre lake' is a golf/fishing pond inside the resort and no RV sites were tied to it.
DISCOUNTS: good_sam / military true stay as derived from the Good Sam directory; the operator site does not mention either.
